campaign_context.qualification_boundary: An exact vendor-authored route occupancy witness establishes topology use, not an edge-specific selector encoding or silicon conduction.

origin_policy.negative_evidence: Any retained silicon-negative edge is hard-blocked under every emission policy. Campaign-specific promotion counts are tracked separately from later position-specific route exclusions.
origin_policy.raw_material_excluded: No vendor executable, SDK snapshot, raw route.tx, routed checkpoint, manual, or private filesystem path is shipped by this manifest.
origin_policy.vendor_material: Normalized facts recovered from vendor tools or artifacts are labelled vendor-derived; they are not represented as independently derived.

routing_evidence_classes.conflict-free-physical-observation: exact physical selector pair; no observed conflict
routing_evidence_classes.decoded-mesh-template-prediction: decoded template extrapolation; not an edge-specific observation
routing_evidence_classes.unanimous-relative-observation: tile-relative selector pair unanimous across physical observations
routing_evidence_classes.unresolved: no complete selector encoding; emission still fails unless separately overridden
routing_evidence_classes.vendor-corpus-absolute-majority: absolute selector pair chosen by corpus majority; conflict not excluded
routing_evidence_classes.vendor-corpus-conflicted-majority: majority pair from a physical edge with two or more preserved observed variants
routing_evidence_classes.vendor-corpus-context-majority: complete destination-field selection chosen by corpus majority
routing_evidence_classes.vendor-corpus-geometric-majority: geometric selector component chosen by corpus majority

warning: NON-RELEASE: datasets mix independently decoded structure, normalized vendor-derived observations, silicon tests, enumerated topology, statistical majorities, conflicts, and predictions. Availability is not qualification.
